Title: GA: Azure Logic Apps Designer for Consumption

Body.Content:
We're thrilled to announce the general availability of the new Azure Logic Apps Designer for Consumption, revolutionizing your workflow experience with unparalleled speed, smoothness, and reliability. Unifying the designer experience across all supported platforms, including standard Azure Logic Apps, the Azure Logic Apps Visual Studio Code extension, and consumption Azure Logic Apps in the portal, ensures seamless usability and familiarity wherever you work.

Key Benefits:

  • Enhanced Speed: Experience optimized loading and rendering capabilities for swift handling of complex workflows, ensuring uninterrupted productivity.

  • Simplified Workflow Management: Say goodbye to confusion with improved support for intricate 'run after' scenarios, providing a clearer and more user-friendly layout.

  • Intuitive Interface: Enjoy streamlined navigation and editing, making tasks easier and more efficient.

  • Innovative Features: Benefit from new functionalities such as copy and paste actions, re-submission from action, and a simplified token picker, enhancing your workflow customization capabilities.

  • Accessibility: Designed with inclusivity in mind, with enhanced keyboard navigation for improved usability.

  • Community Collaboration: The new designer is open-source, inviting community feedback for continuous improvement, ensuring that your needs are met effectively.

Read more details here.
